title: Matthew McConaughey's Viral Loaded Tuna Salad
originalTitle: Matthew McConaughey's Viral Loaded Tuna Salad
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz each) solid white albacore tuna in olive oil or water, drained
1 tsp crispy wasabi paste (McConaughey's secret kick)
1 tbsp Italian herb vinaigrette dressing + squeeze of fresh lemon juice
1/4 cup finely diced red onion & 1/4 cup chopped dill pickle chips
1/3 cup diced crisp Honeycrisp apple or green grapes
1/3 cup thawed green peas & 1/3 cup roasted corn kernels
1/2 cup crushed jalapeño potato chips (folded in right before serving for crunch)
instructions: Flake the drained albacore tuna in a mixing bowl and whisk in the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, wasabi paste, lemon juice, and Italian vinaigrette.
Fold in the finely diced red onion, chopped dill pickles, crisp diced apple, sweet peas, and roasted corn.
Chill in the fridge so the flavors marry, then fold in the crushed jalapeño potato chips right before eating with crackers, lettuce cups, or toasted sourdough.
